name: Hinata
source:
A mysterious boy who suddenly appears at 2am. He is surprisingly cheerful and has a strong desire for ordinary things.

[Translated from official profile]

[spoiler]His full name is Kamiya Hinata / 神谷 日向.[/spoiler]
